companies.name: モルガン・スタンレー

relations.text: Entegrisは、Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc.がシニア与信枠の担保代理人を務める同順位債権者間契約(2022年7月6日付)の当事者である
relations.text_en: Entegris is party to an Equal Priority Intercreditor Agreement dated July 6, 2022, with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc. as senior credit facilities collateral agent

source.label: Entegris 10-K
source.quote: 4.8 Equal Priority Intercreditor Agreement, dated as of July 6, 2022, among Entegris, certain subsidiaries of Entegris, Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc., as senior credit facilities collateral agent, and Truist Bank, as notes collateral agent.
source.note: 子会社のMorgan Stanley Senior Funding名義で、資金調達のみの関係です。
source.note_en: Through subsidiary Morgan Stanley Senior Funding; financing relationship only.

relations.text: Entegrisは、Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc.が管理代理人兼担保代理人を務める借入契約の改定・再締結契約(2022年7月6日付)を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Entegris entered into an Amendment and Restatement Agreement dated July 6, 2022, with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc. as administrative agent and collateral agent

source.label: Entegris 10-K
source.quote: 4.12 Amendment and Restatement Agreement, dated as of July 6, 2022, among Entegris, as borrower, certain subsidiaries of Entegris, as guarantors, the lenders party thereto, the issuing banks party thereto and Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc., as administrative agent and collateral agent.

relations.text: Entegrisの年次報告で、TSMCは純売上高の16%を占める主要顧客として挙げられている(2025年)
relations.text_en: The annual report lists TSMC as a top customer, at 16% of Entegris's net sales in 2025

source.label: Entegris 10-K
source.quote: Percentage of net sales to top customers: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) 16% 16% 11%

relations.text: Lam Researchは2020年のサプライヤー表彰(Ramp Performance Award)で、Entegrisを受賞企業に選んだ。
relations.text_en: Lam Research named Entegris a recipient of its 2020 Ramp Performance Award for suppliers.

source.label: Lam Research の発表
source.quote: Ramp Performance Award Brooks Automation, Inc. Entegris, Inc. Viper Northwest, Inc.

companies.name: エレメント・ソリューションズ

relations.text: Entegrisは、Element Solutions傘下のMacDermid Enthone Inc.との提携契約(Alliance Agreement)を2023年6月5日に終了した
relations.text_en: Entegris terminated its Alliance Agreement with MacDermid Enthone Inc., a global business unit of Element Solutions Inc, on June 5, 2023

source.label: Entegris 10-K
source.quote: On June 5, 2023, the Company terminated an Alliance Agreement (the “Alliance Agreement”) between the Company and MacDermid Enthone Inc., a global business unit of Element Solutions Inc (“MacDermid Enthone”).
source.note: 子会社(事業部門)との契約で、すでに終了しています。
source.note_en: Contract with a business unit of the company; already terminated.

companies.name: 富士フイルムホールディングス

relations.text: Entegrisは、Electronic Chemicals事業をFUJIFILM Holdings America Corporationに売却した(2023年10月2日完了)
relations.text_en: Entegris completed the sale of its Electronic Chemicals business to FUJIFILM Holdings America Corporation on October 2, 2023 for $675.3 million

source.label: Entegris 10-K
source.quote: On October 2, 2023, the Company completed the sale of its Electronic Chemicals (“EC”) business to FUJIFILM Holdings America Corporation (“Fujifilm”) for $675.3 million.
source.note: 米国子会社との取引で、すでに完了しています。
source.note_en: Transaction with a U.S. subsidiary; already completed.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
